cards.back: What an object is made from, such as wood, metal, glass or plastic.
cards.say: material. What an object is made from, such as wood, metal, glass or plastic.

cards.back: A word that describes how a material looks, feels or behaves.
cards.say: property. A word that describes how a material looks, feels or behaves.

cards.back: A hard material is difficult to scratch or dent. Metal and stone are hard.
cards.say: hard. A hard material is difficult to scratch or dent. Metal and stone are hard.

cards.back: A soft material is easy to squash or press. Cotton wool is soft.
cards.say: soft. A soft material is easy to squash or press. Cotton wool is soft.

cards.back: A flexible material bends without breaking. Rubber is flexible.
cards.say: flexible. A flexible material bends without breaking. Rubber is flexible.

cards.back: A stiff material does not bend easily. A wooden ruler is stiff.
cards.say: stiff. A stiff material does not bend easily. A wooden ruler is stiff.

cards.back: A transparent material lets light through so you can see clearly. Clear glass is transparent.
cards.say: transparent. A transparent material lets light through so you can see clearly. Clear glass is transparent.

cards.back: An opaque material does not let light through. Wood is opaque.
cards.say: opaque. An opaque material does not let light through. Wood is opaque.

cards.back: A translucent material lets some light through, but you cannot see clearly. Tracing paper is translucent.
cards.say: translucent. A translucent material lets some light through, but you cannot see clearly. Tracing paper is translucent.

cards.back: A waterproof material does not let water through. Plastic is waterproof.
cards.say: waterproof. A waterproof material does not let water through. Plastic is waterproof.

cards.back: An absorbent material soaks up liquid. A sponge is absorbent.
cards.say: absorbent. An absorbent material soaks up liquid. A sponge is absorbent.

cards.back: A rough surface feels bumpy. Sandpaper is rough.
cards.say: rough. A rough surface feels bumpy. Sandpaper is rough.

cards.back: A smooth surface feels even and flat. Polished glass is smooth.
cards.say: smooth. A smooth surface feels even and flat. Polished glass is smooth.

cards.back: A strong material is hard to break or pull apart.
cards.say: strong. A strong material is hard to break or pull apart.

cards.front: Which material would you choose for a raincoat?
cards.back: A waterproof material, such as plastic, so you stay dry.
cards.say: Which material would you choose for a raincoat? A waterproof material, such as plastic, so you stay dry.

cards.front: Which material would you choose for a window?
cards.back: Glass, because it is transparent.
cards.say: Which material would you choose for a window? Glass, because it is transparent.

cards.front: Which material would you choose to mop up a spill?
cards.back: An absorbent material, such as a cloth or sponge.
cards.say: Which material would you choose to mop up a spill? An absorbent material, such as a cloth or sponge.

cards.front: Which material would you choose for a bouncy ball?
cards.back: Rubber, because it is flexible and springy.
cards.say: Which material would you choose for a bouncy ball? Rubber, because it is flexible and springy.

cards.front: Which material would you choose for a cooking pot?
cards.back: Metal, because it is strong and heats up well.
cards.say: Which material would you choose for a cooking pot? Metal, because it is strong and heats up well.

cards.front: Why are curtains often made of cloth?
cards.back: Cloth is opaque and soft, so it blocks the light and hangs well.
cards.say: Why are curtains often made of cloth? Cloth is opaque and soft, so it blocks the light and hangs well.

cards.front: Is wood a natural material or a made material?
cards.back: Natural. It comes from trees.
cards.say: Is wood a natural material or a made material? Natural. It comes from trees.

cards.front: Is plastic a natural material or a made material?
cards.back: Man-made. People make it in factories.
cards.say: Is plastic a natural material or a made material? Man-made. People make it in factories.

cards.back: Wood and wool. Cotton, stone and clay are natural too.
cards.say: Name two natural materials. Wood and wool. Cotton, stone and clay are natural too.

cards.front: True or false: A metal spoon is flexible.
cards.back: False. A metal spoon is stiff and hard.
cards.say: True or false: A metal spoon is flexible. False. A metal spoon is stiff and hard.

cards.front: Which is more absorbent, kitchen paper or foil?
cards.back: Kitchen paper. Foil does not soak up water.
cards.say: Which is more absorbent, kitchen paper or foil? Kitchen paper. Foil does not soak up water.
